glossary.Symmetrical swing point: The -1.0 measured_swing_projection level, i.e. a 1:1 measured move from the selected opening-price anchor through the Judas Swing.

custom_signals.name: judas_swing
custom_signals.plain_definition: The manipulation leg: an initial fake move away from the opening price, opposite to the real move, before the expansion.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: lowest(low, ny_minute / tf_minutes + 1) < custom_signals.midnight_open AND close > custom_signals.midnight_open

custom_signals.name: measured_swing_projection
custom_signals.plain_definition: A Fibonacci projection family drawn from a Judas Swing back to its opening-price anchor; the presenter uses the exact levels -0.27, -0.68, -1.0, -1.62, and -2.0 depending on which one overlaps the intended PD array.

custom_signals.name: overlapping_pd_array
custom_signals.plain_definition: A fair value gap that shares price with another PD array (order block) on the same timeframe; the shared range is the entry zone.
custom_signals.numeric_definition: max(bullish_fvg[0].gap_low, bullish_ob[0].zone_low) <= min(bullish_fvg[0].gap_high, bullish_ob[0].zone_high) AND NOT bullish_fvg[0].filled AND NOT bullish_ob[0].invalidated

sequence: Pick the active opening-price anchor for the profile being traded: London, New York midnight, weekly open, or monthly open.
Measure the Judas Swing away from that anchor and project the presenter's Fibonacci levels from the swing extreme back through the opening price.
Keep only the projection level that overlaps the higher-timeframe PD array acting as draw on liquidity.
Use separate entry models to participate during the distribution phase while holding for that overlapped target.

invalidation.text: If the time of day indicates the session is ending (e.g., entering London Close after a large move), do not expect further projection levels to be hit.

filters.text: Swing projections alone are just indications; they must be combined with overlapping PD arrays to be valid targets.
Keep time in mind: 'the meat is in the middle'. Do not expect the extreme monthly target to be hit in the first few days of the month; allow the trend to develop.
